artifact_observations.reasoning: The metal rings appear physically implausible. They look like twisted wire fragments rather than solid, functional mechanical rings. The connection points to the spine are vague and lack the necessary structural hardware (hinges/levers) seen in real binders.
The blue element hangs unnaturally. It appears to float slightly away from the rings and lacks the physical tension or curvature expected of a heavy paper divider hanging from metal rings.
The texture is overly uniform and plastic-like, lacking the subtle micro-texture or light reflection variations typical of real binder materials.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the ring mechanisms. In AI-generated images, these often fail to look like functional hardware, appearing instead as melted wire or abstract shapes. Verify if the rings are actually closed loops and if they logically connect to the spine. Also, check if the blue page interacts correctly with the rings (i.e., holes aligned, hanging naturally).
